newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ house price index rises 0.6 pct in June qtr-VNZ.
newsitem.headline: NZ house price index rises 0.6 pct in June qtr-VNZ.

text.p: Valuation New Zealand said on Monday its New Zealand house price index rose 0.6 percent in the June quarter, compared to a 2.3 percent rise in the March quarter.
The Auckland index fell 0.2 percent in the June quarter after rising 3.1 percent in the March quarter.

The index for Wellington rose 3.0 percent in the June quarter, from a 2.5 percent rise in the March quarter. For all urban areas the index was up 0.5 percent from a 2.4 percent rise the previous quarter.
The national index has a base of 1,000 at December 1989 and stood at 1,535 at June 30.
